description: Implementation of QuicWriteBlockedList class managing write blocking and stream priorities in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicWriteBlockedList
classes.description: Manages a list of streams that are write-blocked, handling priorities and batching.

classes.name: QuicWriteBlockedList::StaticStreamCollection
classes.description: Manages static streams within the write-blocked list.

methods.name: QuicWriteBlockedList::ShouldYield
methods.description: Determines if a stream should yield based on static collection and scheduler.

methods.name: QuicWriteBlockedList::PopFront
methods.description: Pops the next stream to write, considering static streams and priorities.

methods.name: QuicWriteBlockedList::RegisterStream
methods.description: Registers a stream with its priority and static status.

methods.name: QuicWriteBlockedList::UnregisterStream
methods.description: Unregisters a stream from the list.

methods.name: QuicWriteBlockedList::UpdateStreamPriority
methods.description: Updates the priority of a stream.

methods.name: QuicWriteBlockedList::UpdateBytesForStream
methods.description: Updates the remaining bytes for a stream's batch write.

methods.name: QuicWriteBlockedList::AddStream
methods.description: Marks a stream as ready to write.

methods.name: QuicWriteBlockedList::IsStreamBlocked
methods.description: Checks if a stream is currently blocked.

methods.name: QuicWriteBlockedList::StaticStreamCollection::IsRegistered
methods.description: Checks if a static stream is registered.

methods.name: QuicWriteBlockedList::StaticStreamCollection::SetBlocked
methods.description: Sets a static stream as blocked.

methods.name: QuicWriteBlockedList::StaticStreamCollection::UnblockFirstBlocked
methods.description: Unblocks the first blocked static stream.
